text: {"sql": "SELECT agv_id, shift_code, COUNT(*) AS total_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'aborted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aborted_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'late' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_tasks, SUM(delay_s) AS total_delay_s FROM sf_fleet.agv_tasks GROUP BY agv_id, shift_code ORDER BY total_delay_s DESC, aborted_tasks DESC, late_tasks DESC LIMIT 20", "columns": ["agv_id", "shift_code", "total_tasks", "aborted_tasks", "late_tasks", "total_delay_s"], "purpose": "Rank AGV task reliability by agv and shift, counting aborted and late tasks and summing delay seconds"}
